title: 美联储连续第5次维持利率：3.5%-3.75%不变，9∶3鹰派异议创近年新高，9月加息窗口打开
summary: FOMC以9票赞成、3票反对（哈马克、卡什卡利、洛根主张加息25bp）决议维持联邦基金利率目标区间3.5%-3.75%，为连续第五次按兵不动。上次降息还要追溯到2025年12月。鲍威尔表示经济仍稳健扩张但不确定性上升，部分源于中东冲突。
why: 五连停叠到3张鹰派异议票，9月加息预期升温将推高VIX与期权隐含波动率；sell put策略需留意短期波动放大风险；利率预期重定价可能压制高倍估值成长股。

title: Microsoft Q4 FY2026 blows past estimates: revenue $90B, Azure +43%, stock surges 16% — largest single-day gain in 18 years
summary: Microsoft posted Q4 revenue of $90B (est $87.7B) and EPS $4.74 (est $4.25). Azure growth accelerated to 43% YoY, guided 45% next quarter, and Azure crossed $100B annual revenue milestone. Copilot seats exceeded 30M. Stock jumped 15-16%, adding ~$450B in market cap, the largest single-day gain in 18 years.
why: 微软AI变现能力得到验证，大幅提振市场对AI资本开支的信心，直接引发7月30日纳指全面反弹；同类AI受益股（谷歌、英伟达）短期情绪提振，期权卖方注意隐含波动率回落可能。

title: US stocks surge Jul 30: S&P 500 +1.7% to 7,437; Nasdaq +2.8%, best session since June, powered by Microsoft
summary: US equities staged a broad rebound Jul 30: S&P 500 rose 1.7% to 7,437.64, Nasdaq gained 2.8% to 25,122.18, DJIA up 613 points (+1.2%) to 52,208. Rally driven by Microsoft’s historic 16% single-day gain after blowout Q4 results, partially reversing the prior session’s post-Fed sell-off.
why: 大盘强力反弹修复美联储决议后的悲观情绪，科技权重股领涨为相关仓位提供正向估值支撑；期权角度：短期隔含波动率或因大涨而压缩，可关注sell covered call机会。

title: Chip stocks shed $1T+ in two-day rout: SK Hynix -14.7%, Micron -10.3%, SanDisk -14%, Samsung -13%; Nasdaq 100 enters correction
summary: A global semiconductor selloff July 28-29 wiped out $1T+ in market value. SK Hynix closed 14.65% lower, Samsung -13%, Micron -10.34%, AMD -8%, Intel -6%, SanDisk -14%, Kioxia -18%, TSMC -3%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell for a 4th consecutive session. Triggers: CXMT’s blockbuster Shanghai debut (see separate item), news of Chinese mass-production of DUV lithography machines, and broader AI-spending-skepticism.
why: SK海力士和美光是持仓标的直接受害仓位；CXMT上市引发的供过于求担忧有可能压刽HBM/DRAM定价中长期预期，需重新评估sell put行权价层次设置。

title: CXMT surges 466% on Shanghai debut, hits 3.3T yuan market cap; becomes China’s most valuable listed company and sparks global chip panic
summary: China’s DRAM maker CXMT (ChangXin Memory) surged 466% on its A-share debut Jul 27, raising $8.6B in Asia’s largest IPO of 2026. Market cap hit 3.3 trillion yuan ($488B), surpassing ICBC as China’s most valuable onshore-listed company. CXMT holds 7.67% of global DRAM market; guided H1 2026 revenue of 110-120B yuan, up 7x YoY. Debut triggered the Jul 28 global chip selloff.
why: 延续报道：CXMT上市是中国内存芒片国产化里程碑，其快速扩张引发全球DRAM/HBM定价担忧，直接导致SK海力士、美光持仓的重大利空；同时作为A股风向标的市场重要事件。

title: China says US pledged to cap replacement tariffs at 20%; new 12.5% Section 301 tariff on Chinese goods took effect Jul 24
summary: China’s Commerce Ministry disclosed that the US committed to capping replacement Section 301 tariffs on Chinese goods at 20%. The current rate effective Jul 24 is 12.5% (replacing expired 10% global duty), leaving 7.5pp of headroom. Beijing signalled limited near-term escalation risk ahead of Xi’s planned US trip.
why: 延续报道：7月24日新关税生效后贸易形势持续演变，20%上限承诺有助减轻Temu/拼多多跨境业务及出口型消费品的长期不确定性，整体A/港股情绪受益于谈判维稳信号。

title: Xiaomi launches SkyNomad EREV SUV series (N90 Max / N70 Max) — brand’s first range-extenders; pre-sales open, deliveries September
summary: Xiaomi debuted two extended-range electric SUVs at its Jul 30 Sky Nomad event: N90 Max (7-seat flagship EREV, 5,285mm) and N70 Max (5-seat AWD EREV). First move into EREVs alongside existing SU7/YU7 BEV lineup. Pre-orders now open; launch in September 2026. YU7 cumulative deliveries since June 2025 reached 258,232 units.
why: Sky Nomad进入EREV赛道是小米汽车产品矩阵的关键扩张，上半年交付量仅为年度目标的约1/3，新系列能否开屈0家庭市场是观察小米港股（1810.HK）收入加速的重要指标。
